_comments: Bridge provider registry for the Realtime Bridges subsystem. Each row connects the single realtime agent engine to an external endpoint — a meeting (Zoom/Teams/Meet/Webex/Slack/Discord/LiveKit, plus the in-memory Loopback for development) or a phone call (RingCentral/Twilio/Vonage/OpenAI Direct SIP). SupportedFeatures is an IBridgeProviderFeatures JSON object saying what the row's driver does (omitted flag = not supported). A capability the platform offers but the driver does not carry yet stays off until the driver carries it: the Zoom, Teams, Meet, Webex, Slack and Discord drivers carry audio but no video or screen share. The unit tests of those six drivers and of LiveKit read their rows and check the flags against the driver. STATUS POLICY: a row is 'Active' once its driver ships. Every row is Active except Slack, which stays 'Disabled' until a public join-with-media path to huddles is confirmed (see its Description). Every row has a fixed primaryKey (a new row takes one from uuidgen); mj sync push writes the sync blocks.

fields.Name: Loopback
fields.Description: In-memory echo bridge for development and testing. Loops the agent's outbound audio back as inbound with no external platform.

fields.Name: Zoom
fields.Description: Zoom Meetings bridge. Built first, end-to-end — the reference driver the others mirror. Meeting audio in and out plus marketplace native-invite; the driver carries no video or screen share yet.

fields.Name: Microsoft Teams
fields.Description: Microsoft Teams meeting bridge. Meeting audio in and out plus marketplace native-invite; calendar invite via the agent's Microsoft 365 identity. The driver carries no video or screen share yet.

fields.Name: Google Meet
fields.Description: Google Meet bridge. On-demand and scheduled joins need verification; calendar invite via the agent's Google Workspace identity is the headline path.

fields.Name: Cisco Webex
fields.Description: Cisco Webex meeting bridge. Major enterprise platform (finance, healthcare, government, education). Meeting audio in and out via the Webex bot/embedded-app SDK; the driver carries no video or screen share yet.

fields.Name: Slack
fields.Description: Slack huddle bridge (huddles run on Amazon Chime). The driver carries huddle audio in and out, not video or screen share. Gating unknown: confirm a public join-with-media path to huddles before promoting from Disabled.

fields.Name: Discord
fields.Description: Discord voice-channel bridge. First-class voice channels and a mature bot API make media access easy. Strong for community, education, gaming, and some business use.

fields.Name: RingCentral
fields.Description: RingCentral telephony bridge (Voice / Call Control API). Outbound dial, inbound routing, DTMF, and call transfer over voice. Audio only — no video or screen. (RingCentral Video meetings could be a separate provider row later.)

fields.Name: Twilio
fields.Description: Twilio CPaaS telephony bridge (lead telephony provider). Inbound DID routing, outbound dial, DTMF, and call transfer over voice. Audio only — no video or screen.

fields.Name: Vonage
fields.Description: Vonage CPaaS telephony bridge. Inbound DID routing, outbound dial, DTMF, and call transfer over voice. Audio only — no video or screen.

fields.Name: LiveKit
fields.Description: LiveKit MJ-native room bridge — an SFU we run ourselves rather than connect out to. Open-source, self-hostable, with existing OpenAI/Gemini realtime adapters. Full multi-party AV in an MJ-owned room.

fields.Name: OpenAI Direct SIP
fields.Description: OpenAI Direct SIP telephony bridge with a detached media plane. Inbound SIP call legs terminate directly at OpenAI while MemberJunction attaches a sideband connection for signaling, telemetry, tool execution, and DTMF observation.
